Name: MAGIC_TABLE_PARAM_ST
Description: Weighted spell tables used by preset weapon rolls; a spell already rolled is skipped.

Fields.Name: Spell
Fields.Description: Spell (Magic) this row can roll. Skipped when the weapon already rolled it for its other slot.

Fields.Name: Roll Weight
Fields.Description: Weight of this row in the roll, against the sum of the table's eligible rows. 0: never rolled.
